_comment: SECURITY DEFINER functions the runtime role (app_service) may EXECUTE. A definer function runs as its owner and reads past every tenant policy,
so each one is a way around RLS. scripts/db/provision-app-role.mjs REVOKEs EXECUTE (from PUBLIC and the runtime role) on every definer function
NOT listed here, on every deploy (revokeUnreviewedDefinerExecute), and tests/db/security-definer-functions.dbtest.ts fails on any callable one not listed.
Add an entry only with a reason saying why it cannot cross a tenant, or what its caller must guarantee.
status: reviewed | reviewed-risk (safe only because of who calls it). Evidence: docs/evidence/D3/2026-09-29-definer-functions/, docs/evidence/D3/2026-09-30-definer-revoke/.

public.actor_name(p_user_id integer).reason: Called by server/services/tenant/actor-names.ts. Returns another user's name only when the tenant scope shares a membership or an audit row with them (checked in the body), or in the platform/pre-auth scope. Owned by the actor-names lane (…01YZFCXR).

public.audit_logs_archive_delete(p_ids u.reason: The audit_logs archive door (D5): refuses unless current_user is audit_archiver, which only the archiver's own connection is. Tenant-neutral by design.

public.purge_tenant_vault_records(p_org.reason: The tenant purge's one door to delete Vault versions (VR-07, migrations/20260926_vault_documents_record_immutability.sql). Called only by purgeVaultVersions in server/services/tenant/tenant-offboarding.ts, behind requirePlatformAdmin and the purge's code preconditions. It takes the organization as an argument and deletes past RLS, so it is safe only because of who calls it; the body refuses unless the session is in the platform scope (app_super_admin, or RLS enforcement off), the organization is pending_deletion, and no legal hold on it is active. Owned by the AnA client-files lane (…01DiJJAk).
